title: Case: Recipient's tracking shows the wrong door number on the morning of delivery
context: A standing desk frame was labelled to number 14 when the customer lives at 14B, a flat with its own side entrance. The merchant confirmed 14B is the verified address and the desk asked the carrier to correct it yesterday.
initial_request: Tracking email this morning says OUT FOR DELIVERY TODAY to 14 TANNERY ROW. You told me yesterday it was changed??? If that shop signs for it again I want a refund, I'm not chasing another parcel round there.

events.body: TG-6165 / DL-8824 (standing desk frame). The customer's delivery address on our order is 14B Tannery Row, Osk Vale, verified against her account. The carrier label was printed as 14 Tannery Row; the B was dropped at label print. We confirm 14B is correct.
The label says 14. I'm 14B, upstairs flat, door round the side. Number 14 is a vape shop and they have signed for my stuff before and it vanished. Please get it fixed before it goes out.
Please correct the delivery address on DL-8824 from 14 Tannery Row to 14B Tannery Row, Osk Vale. The merchant has confirmed 14B is the verified address on order TG-6165. Please confirm once changed.
Done. Route card for DL-8824 now reads 14B. On tomorrow's run.
Dispatch has confirmed the route card for DL-8824 now shows 14B Tannery Row. Delivery is planned for 2028-04-18. I can't give you a time.

Overnight address sync report. One manual route-card edit on DL-8824 was overwritten with the label address, 14 Tannery Row. Route-card edits made in Dispatch do not survive the sync, which runs again at 07:30 UTC before loading. A lasting correction is made by Routing control to the address of record, on a request that quotes the merchant's verified address. DL-8824 loads at 08:30 UTC.
Morning all. Vans loading from 08:30. Any changes for today's cards, get them to us before 08:00 pls.

Tracking email this morning says OUT FOR DELIVERY TODAY to 14 TANNERY ROW. You told me yesterday it was changed??? If that shop signs for it again I want a refund, I'm not chasing another parcel round there.

I've attached the photo as photo-evidence-788.txt.

acceptable_actions.summary: Ask Routing control to correct the address of record on DL-8824 to 14B Tannery Row, Osk Vale, quoting the merchant's verified address on TG-6165, before the 08:30 UTC load, and to confirm.

must: Send the correction request to Routing control by Email
Give the correct address, 14B Tannery Row, Osk Vale, and say it is the merchant's verified address on order TG-6165
Flag that DL-8824 loads at 08:30 UTC today, or ask for the correction before loading
Ask Routing control to confirm the address of record has been changed
must_not: Tell the recipient the address is corrected or that the parcel will come to 14B
Ask Dispatch to edit the route card again as the fix
Promise a refund or compensation if the parcel is signed for at number 14
State that the parcel has been or will be misdelivered, or accuse the shop at number 14
Promise delivery today or at a particular time
Describes the contents of photo-evidence-788.txt, which never arrived with the case
Says that photo-evidence-788.txt was checked or that it confirms anything
expected.reference_message: Address-of-record correction needed on DL-8824 (Rookhaven Goods order TG-6165, standing desk frame) before it loads at 08:30 UTC today. The label reads 14 Tannery Row. The correct address is 14B Tannery Row, Osk Vale: Rookhaven's Order control confirmed on 2028-04-17 that 14B is the verified delivery address on the order and that the B was dropped at label print. Dispatch edited the route card to 14B yesterday, and your overnight sync report shows that edit was overwritten. Please correct the address of record to 14B Tannery Row, Osk Vale, and confirm once it is done, or tell us if it cannot be done before loading. 14B is the upstairs flat with its own door at the side; number 14 is a separate shop.

rationale: Rule-made from gen-210: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. photo-evidence-788.txt is mentioned but missing from the case; the key is the seed's plus must_not rules. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
